macro_definition: Eligible months equal within target; targets equal within site; sites equal pooled
normalization: Error divided by target training annual-mean scale

bootstrap.unit: target within site, retaining all eligible months together
bootstrap.scope: Conditional target-cluster uncertainty; excludes training-seed and temporal-generalization uncertainty
bootstrap.zero_denominator_policy: Return null CI if any replicate has undefined F0 normalization

interpretation: Exploratory necessity screen; repeated topic-search error is not controlled
